title: Is the Parthenon built on the golden ratio?

probes.question: True or false: Leonardo's own writings support the claim that the Mona Lisa uses golden ratio proportions.
What is the status of the claim that the Parthenon's proportions show the golden ratio?

image.alt: The columns and pediment of the Parthenon on the Acropolis in Athens against a deep blue sky.

body.question: The golden ratio is said to hide in famous buildings and paintings. What do we know about the Parthenon?
options: It was designed around the golden ratio
Many claim so, but the claim is largely discredited
body.reveal: Many of its proportions are alleged to show the golden ratio, but this has largely been discredited. The same goes for the Mona Lisa: the idea is not supported by Leonardo's own writings. Some golden ratio claims rest on dubious fits to data.
